fit: same egg isolate with or without dried-leaf-derived lemon balm
assessment: Solberg Table 2 shows week-12 HAM-D means 9.4 egg isolate and 10.3 with added lemon balm. The active arms were not significantly different and the contrast has no interval. Incomplete endpoint denominators and different preparation and population prevent a brewed-tea direction.

fit: lemon balm in two oral botanical mixtures and Beck depression
assessment: Table 3 per-protocol means after 14 days are 5.6 four-extract, 10.5 three-extract and 11.3 placebo. Both active arms have lemon balm, valerian and passionflower. The active contrast changes butterbur. No single-ingredient or Parkinson comparison.

fit: three-ingredient extract capsules and day-30 Hamilton depression
assessment: Figure 5 reports mean scores 17.3 to 1.2 combination and 18.0 to 20.8 placebo, 30 per arm. The signed-rank caption and retrospective registry do not reconcile with the arm comparison. A 2024 conference abstract likely reports the same experiment with differences. No isolated brewed comparison.

fit: aqueous extract capsule with secondary DASS-21 depression
assessment: Completed registration with 99 participants has no posted results. Original P135 supplies no estimate. A compatible thesis abstract does not name the registry or report a depression-specific effect.

fit: mixed plant formulation and secondary Hamilton depression
assessment: Five-arm study includes a mixed Melissa formulation and a secondary depression endpoint at 12 weeks. Registry status unknown and no results posted. Ingredient attribution would remain limited.

fit: dried lemon balm leaf capsules and HADS depression after cardiac surgery
assessment: Original Persian Table 2 (p40) gives HADS depression 11.48 to 7.28 active and 10.98 to 8.73 placebo, 40 randomized per arm. The displayed 1.95-point change difference is descriptive and the stated t and p pair does not reconcile. Population and capsule preparation limit transfer.
